sections.title: SCOPE
paras: When a child can't stay safely with their parents, the people best positioned to care for them are often already in their life: a grandmother, an aunt, a former teacher, a neighbor who's been there for years. Children placed with kin move homes less often, change schools less often, and stay with their siblings far more often. They keep their community, their culture, and their sense of who they are, and they're more likely to say they always felt loved. It's better for parents too, since children placed with relatives return home at a higher rate than those in non-relative foster homes. Federal law requires agencies to make diligent efforts to find and notify relatives when a child comes into care. In practice it's slow detective work. Social workers dig through paper files, run searches across disconnected systems, and draw family trees by hand. Children too often end up with strangers while a relative was there the whole time.

Binti's Family Finding & Engagement module puts that work in one place. Workers can search public records without leaving Binti, generate and export genograms automatically, send templated outreach in multiple languages, and track every connection to a child over time.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: Binti PMs drive the strategy and execution of Binti's roadmap. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Sales, and customer-facing teams, alongside an experienced and ambitious group of fellow PMs. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Family Finding & Engagement’s next chapter — smarter, more configurable, and leveraging AI to enable step changes in outcomes. This role reports to our Head of Product.

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for Family Finding & Engagement.

Drive the metrics that matter: kinship placement rates, connections identified per child, time from case opening to first relative contact, outreach response rates, and placement stability.

Identify where AI can transform family finding — inferring relationships from unstructured case records, surfacing connections buried in notes, drafting and translating outreach, prioritizing which leads are worth a worker's time.
Prototype rapidly using AI tools (Claude, Figma, Cursor, v0) to test ideas with users in days, not weeks. We expect PMs to use AI aggressively in their own workflows.
Spend real time shadowing the social workers doing this work, and hearing from kin who've been on the receiving end of an outreach letter. Deep user understanding is non-negotiable.

sections.title: Claim Health is the AI Revenue Platform for Post-Acute Care.
paras:
With the US population aging and preference for care moving to the home, post-acute care (home health, skilled nursing, home care, hospice) is one of the fastest growing verticals within healthcare. Post-acute providers operate across fragmented systems, manual workflows, and reactive processes that create operational drag and financial uncertainty. Claim Health replaces this fragmentation with an intelligent, software-driven platform that unifies data, automates execution, and enables real-time decision-making across revenue-critical operations.

We’re building an adaptive platform that brings clarity, predictability, and scale to environments where reliability matters.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're hiring our first Customer Success Manager to partner with our agencies after they go live and take each one to the next level.

Our platform powers a large share of each agency's revenue cycle: referral intake, eligibility and benefits verification, insurance mapping, prior authorization, and admit decisions. As agencies grow with us, there's always more value to unlock, whether that's new referral sources, new branches, new service lines, or more of their workflow running on Claim Health. You'll own that growth.

You'll be a strategic partner to agency leadership, backed by data. You'll bring each agency a clear picture of its performance, a plan for where to go next, and the follow-through to get there. You'll work side by side with our operations, product, and engineering team, and what you learn from customers will directly shape what we build.

sections.title: Own Agency Partnerships
bullets: Serve as the strategic partner to home health and hospice agency leadership, from intake directors to executives

sections.title: What you’ll do:

You’ll work closely with leads in Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, and Technical Implementation to ensure partner needs are represented and coordinated internally. sections.title: Owning implementation at scale

sections.title: Driving adoption through testing and refining

ashby:deepgram:9762d2a1-3d07-4e65-a0bb-6.summary:
Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our…

sections.title: Operating Principles
paras: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:
We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.
bullets: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

sections.title: AI-First by Default
paras: We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.
That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.
bullets: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

sections.title: The Role
paras: Deepgram builds the voice AI models that power other companies’ products. We are also building our own line of AI applications — products that put our voice AI directly in the hands of the people who use them, knowledge workers and consumers alike — and those applications are a new revenue stream for the company. We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to define that line and to build it into a profitable business.

This is a product management role in the conventional sense: you own the product, its direction, and its decisions, and engineering builds it. What sets the role apart is the moment. The team, the models, and the first applications are in place. The strategy for the line — which products we build, for whom, and how they make money — is yours to set, to defend with evidence, and to keep steady while the company’s attention on it stays high. You report to the VP of Self-Serve.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the strategy for Deepgram’s AI applications: decide which products the line consists of, who they are for, and why they win; write it down; defend it to executives; and keep the direction stable while the team builds.
Own the roadmap and its decisions — what ships, in what order, with which tradeoffs — from the applications we have today to the ones we have not built yet.
Build the business: acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, with the metrics, the targets, and a weekly read of whether the product is working and the business is becoming profitable.
Represent the product with partners and customers, and own what we commit to deliver and when.

Run the team’s operating rhythm — a hypothesis, a shipped change, an honest measurement, the next bet — with real usage by real people as the bar, starting with Deepgram’s own employees as the first users.
Partner daily with research on the models, with engineering and design on the build, and with marketing on the launch; bring the user’s voice into every decision.
Prototype. Mockups, wireframes, and working prototypes are how you communicate; using the product every day is how you know it.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: Xnurta, is an AI-native retail media and advertising optimization platform built for brands, sellers, and agencies on Amazon and beyond. We combine multi-agent AI systems, advanced predictive analytics, and deep domain expertise to deliver unparalleled advertising performance.

Thousands of advertisers run real budget through our platform every day. We are past the “does this work” stage and squarely in the “how fast can we grow this” stage — which is exactly why this role exists.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We are hiring a Growth Product Manager who owns the whole path from “never heard of Xnurta” to “can’t run ads without it.”

This is a hybrid role on purpose. Half of it is growth product: you own the funnel as a product surface — signup, onboarding, activation, first value, expansion — and you ship against it with engineering and design. The other half is product marketing: you decide what we say about the product, why it beats the alternative, and how every launch actually lands with advertisers and with our own sales and CS teams.
If you have only ever written positioning docs, or only ever run A/B tests on a signup flow, this will stretch you. That is the point. Growth at an AI-native company is one loop, not two departments.

sections.title: Growth Loops & Activation
bullets: Own the activation and expansion funnel end-to-end — signup, connect-your-ad-account, first optimization, first measurable lift, second seat, second brand.
Instrument it honestly. Find the three steps where people actually drop, and go fix them with engineering rather than explaining them in a deck.
Run a real experiment cadence: hypothesis, sample size, ship, read, kill or scale. We want a track record of shipped tests, not a backlog of proposed ones.
Build self-serve paths into a business that has historically been sales-led, and be clear-eyed about where self-serve stops and a human should take over.

sections.title: Positioning & Messaging
bullets: Own how Xnurta is described — category, narrative, the one sentence a busy brand manager repeats to their boss.
Turn genuinely hard technical capability (multi-agent optimization, predictive pacing, generative insight) into claims that are specific, provable, and free of AI theater.
Keep a live view of the competitive set — Pacvue, Skai, Perpetua, Amazon’s own tooling — and know exactly where we win, where we lose, and what to do about it.
Price and package with product and finance. Packaging is a growth lever, not a spreadsheet exercise.

ashby:fulcrum:5439b91e-e0fa-4eac-9dda-1e.summary: We’ve partnered with an independent, consulting-led digital agency in Sydney that works with some of the world’s most recognised brands, in Australia and overseas. After nearly two decades in search, media and data, they’re investing in how brands earn visibility beyond their own websites, and the outreach team sits at the centre of it.

sections.title: The role
paras: Every good placement does two jobs. It tells a brand’s story to the people who read it, and it makes that brand easier to find every time someone searches for what it sells, whether that’s on Google, in an AI answer or on Reddit. This role runs the work that makes both happen.

If you work in PR, most of it will sound familiar: finding the angle, pitching journalists, moving quickly when a request lands and keeping a client confident when coverage is slow. Those are the hardest skills to teach, and they’re exactly what the team needs. You’ll learn the search side alongside SEO specialists who work in it every day.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Run digital PR campaigns built to earn links and mentions on high-authority sites, so every placement improves a brand’s visibility in search, not just its coverage count
Choose target publications and websites using SEO and GEO criteria, such as authority, relevance and how often AI tools cite them, then pitch journalists, editors and site owners to secure placements
Help brands appear in AI answers by getting them into the articles and listicles that tools like ChatGPT and Google’s AI Overviews draw from
Respond to journalist requests daily, often within 24 hours, turning reactive opportunities into quality links with the right client expert and a brand-safe response
Analyse competitors’ backlink profiles and find unlinked brand mentions to reclaim, so each client’s outreach plan has a clear rationale
Report on what the work did for organic performance, using tools like Ahrefs and Google Search Console, and present it to clients as part of their wider SEO and GEO strategy
Own a portfolio of Australian and international clients as their day-to-day contact, working alongside the SEO and content teams on integrated campaigns
Line manage one junior team member, and help shape new programs around Reddit and AI visibility as the offering grows

sections.title: What you’ll bring
bullets: A few years in a PR, comms or digital PR agency, with campaigns you’re proud of and journalist relationships you built yourself
Experience managing clients directly: setting expectations, delivering difficult news and giving direction without someone signing off every call
Strong writing, from a sharp three-line pitch to longer-form content, and the ability to adapt to someone else’s tone of voice
Comfort with numbers: you can read a report, find the story in it and present it clearly, and a spreadsheet doesn’t put you off
Experience managing or mentoring someone, in a professional setting or elsewhere
Any exposure to SEO, link building or search tools is a bonus, not a requirement. Former journalists who’ve moved into PR or content are very welcome.

sections.title: Who this role is for
paras: The hiring manager put it simply: she doesn’t expect to find someone who knows all of it, so she’d rather find someone who’s interested in all of it. Expect a lot of fast learning in the first six months, with strong support around you while you do it.

You’re a self-starter. You see what needs doing and you do it, and you have opinions about how things could work better. You’ll have real freedom to shape the role around your strengths, which suits people who aren’t waiting for a brief to land.

You’re also curious about where PR is heading. People increasingly discover brands through search, AI tools and communities, not just the news. You don’t need the answers yet, but you want to be part of working them out.
bullets: You want to stay in brand PR, events and media relations, without caring how coverage is measured
You prefer a fixed routine and a clearly defined brief
You’d rather an account manager held the client relationship

sections.title: About The Role
paras: At Grow Therapy, we believe mental healthcare should feel personal, empowering, and accessible - never confusing or transactional. That’s why we’re reimagining the client experience to be proactive, compassionate, and guided from the very first step.

As a Specialist I, Client Success (Retention) , you’ll play a key role in helping people move from intention to action in their mental health journey. You’ll connect with clients who’ve missed or canceled appointments, or who may be feeling uncertain about continuing care.

Your job is to meet them where they are with empathy, clarity, and encouragement, and help them move forward. Whether that’s navigating provider fit, rebooking appointments, or simply offering a listening ear, you’ll make it easier for people to get the care they deserve, especially when the path feels uncertain.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Have live, high-empathy conversations with clients who’ve canceled, no-showed, or started to disengage , most connected through an autodialer first pass, and help them rebook, rematch, or take their next step in care.

Coach clients through key moments of decision-making , providing clarity on platform tools (e.g., messaging, rescheduling, rematching), addressing hesitation, and offering expert provider match guidance.
Document every conversation for a clean handoff so partner teams handling follow-up can pick up where you left off, and so we can spot trends across the client journey.

Partner with internal teams including Clinical, Provider Operations, Support, and our BPO partner team to resolve issues quickly, share insights, and ensure a seamless handoff for escalated or complex cases.
Work across payor-specific programs , learning the coverage and program details (like EAP session limits or referral requirements) that shape each client’s path back to care.

Champion continuous improvement by identifying recurring pain points or engagement barriers, advocating for client needs, and contributing to cross-functional efforts to enhance the overall care experience.

ashby:join9am:55fe8325-3fa8-4894-b4fe-9a.summary:
9amHealth is an AI-enabled virtual specialty care platform focused on managing high-cost chronic conditions at scale. The company partners with employers, health plans, and pharmacy benefit managers to deliver comprehensive, cost-effective medical care for individuals living with obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and dyslipidemia. Members receive access to specialized clinicians, including endocrinologists, obesity medicine specialists, and clinical pharmacists, at-home lab testing, prescription medications, and lifestyle support.

9amHealth was founded in 2021 and is backed by leading healthcare investors like Define Ventures, SemperVirens, 7Wire Ventures, and The Cigna Group Ventures.

sections.title: About the role
paras: We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to help make 9amHealth a care companion that members actively choose and continue to rely on.

Your focus will be sustained, meaningful engagement across the member journey. That means understanding what helps people get started, what gives them a reason to return, and where we lose relevance as their needs change. You’ll help members see progress, navigate medications and care, build sustainable habits, and feel known and supported by their Care Team.

You’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for your product area, working closely with Design, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, and Marketing. Your scope will span member-facing experiences and the supporting care workflows that make those experiences useful and reliable.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Set the engagement roadmap. Translate department goals into a clear set of member problems, opportunities, and measurable outcomes. Build a point of view on where Product can most effectively improve engagement and retention across conditions, treatment stages, and medication pathways.

Understand why members stay—or disengage. Combine interviews, behavioral data, member feedback, and Care Team insights to identify unmet needs and moments where the experience loses value. Understand how motivations and barriers change throughout a member’s journey.

Build experiences worth returning to. Partner with Design and Engineering on onboarding, progress tracking, medication management, lifestyle support, and continuity of care. Help members understand their next steps, build confidence, and return after setbacks without pressure or shame.

Own measurement and learning. Define meaningful engagement metrics, establish baselines, and set targets with your partners. Use funnels, cohorts, and retention analysis to understand behavior over time. Evaluate how changes contribute to sustained member value, retention, and business performance.

Test ideas before scaling them. Frame clear hypotheses, identify the riskiest assumptions, and choose practical ways to learn. Use prototypes, qualitative research, and controlled experiments where appropriate. Define success and guardrails upfront, and decide when to iterate, expand, or stop.

Turn priorities into well-executed products. Write clear requirements, define scope and acceptance criteria, and resolve dependencies and open questions before they slow development. Stay close to implementation, quality, launch readiness, and post-launch results.

Connect the member experience to care delivery. Work with clinicians and operational teams to understand how product decisions affect their workflows. Account for clinical quality, member trust, and Care Team capacity when designing new experiences.

Make and communicate difficult trade-offs. Weigh member value, business impact, evidence, effort, and opportunity cost. Balance near-term improvements with longer-term investments and product quality. Explain decisions clearly, challenge low-impact requests, and adjust direction when evidence changes.

sections.title: What we’re looking for
bullets: Experience owning product outcomes. You bring 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a consumer product or substantial member-facing product area. You can explain the problem you addressed, the decisions you made, and the measurable results.

A track record in engagement and retention. You’ve improved activation, ongoing use, or retention by addressing real user needs. You understand behavior change and can distinguish lasting value from short-lived increases in activity.

Strong product strategy and business judgment. You can turn broad company goals into focused priorities, assess opportunities, and explain how your work contributes to business performance. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

Research and analytical fluency. You conduct discovery directly and combine qualitative insight with product data. You can work with funnels, cohorts, and experiments, question the quality of evidence, and turn findings into action.

Strong execution and technical judgment. You write clear requirements, scope work pragmatically, and collaborate effectively with engineers on feasibility, dependencies, instrumentation, and trade-offs. You take responsibility for what happens after a feature ships.

Cross-functional leadership. You earn trust across disciplines, bring people into decisions at the right time, and communicate clearly with both your team and company leadership. You can lead complex initiatives through influence.

Ownership in a startup environment. You can set direction and work through the details yourself. You proactively resolve gaps, adapt as priorities change, and improve processes without adding unnecessary overhead.

Empathy and sound judgment. You design for people with different abilities, levels of health literacy, and confidence with technology. You balance engagement goals with clinical considerations, accessibility, and member trust.

sections.title: Nice to have
bullets: Experience in digital health, care delivery, or products that support ongoing health behavior change.
Experience with products purchased by employers or health plans and used by individual members.
Familiarity with clinician-facing tools and the connection between member experiences and care operations.
Experience building AI-enabled products, including evaluating when AI improves an experience and where human support is essential.

sections.title: About Lightning Labs
paras: Lightning Labs builds the open infrastructure that makes bitcoin the native money of the internet. We're building a team that's passionate about cryptography, bitcoin, decentralization, security, and privacy. The next wave of users on the network won't only be people. They'll increasingly be software agents that discover services, negotiate, and pay on their own. We think bitcoin and Lightning are the right payment rails for that world, and we're building for it now.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead the product organization: product managers, including a PM who owns our core infrastructure (LND, btcd, btcwallet, and DevOps), plus design and technical content writing. You'll stay hands-on: writing specs, making pricing and launch calls, talking to developers and partners, and building prototypes yourself.

You'll also be AI-native. At Lightning Labs, product work runs through tools like Claude Code and Codex. We use them to explore codebases, draft specs, analyze data, and turn an idea into a working prototype or demo in hours instead of weeks. We expect our Head of Product to work this way by default, and to help the rest of the team do the same.

sections.title: Our Product Stack
paras: You’ll set product direction across the whole stack. Product Managers on the team own the core infrastructure day to day, so your focus will be payments, assets, and agentic commerce. That starts with Wavelength , our newest product: an open-source, agent-first client and SDK built on Ark that lets any app send and receive standard Lightning payments. It is in public alpha, and taking it to broad mainnet adoption is one of your first priorities. Alongside it are Taproot Assets , our protocol for issuing stablecoins and other assets on bitcoin and Lightning, and L402 together with its reverse proxy Aperture , which let machines and agents pay for APIs over HTTP.

Underneath sit the tools node operators use: Lightning Terminal for node and liquidity management, Loop for moving funds between on-chain and off-chain, and Lightning Node Connect for secure remote access. All of it is built on LND , the leading Lightning implementation, used by exchanges, wallets, and payment processors around the world. This is a leadership role for product, which means deciding what we build next and which new products and markets we enter.

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

sections.title: Application Instructions

ashby:whoop:02ef66f5-e73f-4f5b-a82c-9318.summary:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers users to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Product Manager to guide the prioritization, internal alignment, and delivery of needle-moving business systems capabilities. This role will partner closely with Engineers, Systems Analysts, Analytics Engineers, and leaders across WHOOP. In support of the Business Systems team’s goals, you will be expected to own key business KPIs, make excellent prioritization and tradeoff decisions, and deliver new capabilities that help us scale and serve our members.

sections.title: Product Manager II, Business Systems
paras: WHOOP is a complex business. We make a physical product and sell it through many channels around the world. Business Systems is responsible for enabling all facets of our operations: order fulfillment, shipping, and returns; materials planning, supply chain, manufacturing, and inventory management; and membership services.

You will be accountable for improving our business processes in ways that meet our members’ expectations and improve operational efficiency and simplicity, all while ensuring that our data is reliable and accurate. You’ll also be accountable for using AI to create leverage for yourself and your team. This is not a job where you’ll write PRDs like it’s 2015; you’ll be expected to build prototypes, create demo environments, and stay close to the leading edge of technology.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES:
bullets: Drive research, development, and delivery of new capabilities and process improvements across 3rd party and custom-built software.
Bring your strong opinions and good taste to set a strategy, roadmap, and measurable goals for your area and team. Write high quality documents to support the product life cycle.
Be hands-on and use AI tools daily to create prototypes and proofs of concept.
Take ownership of key company metrics related to how good our processes are working for members, how we’re improving operational efficiency, and how reliable our services are.
Own and optimize systems that cut across all parts of our business as noted above.
Collaborate with Engineers and Analysts to break down and prioritize member and employee needs, and define detailed systems & process designs.
Collect and analyze internal and external customer needs and feedback through rigorous research and testing methodologies.
Develop and manage relationships with third-party vendors and service providers to ensure smooth operations.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS:
paras: This role is based full-time in-office at WHOOP HQ in Boston, MA. All candidates must be prepared to be onsite full-time.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.
bullets: Proven experience (3+ years) in Product Management with a clear record of successful delivery and impact collaborating with an engineering team.
Deep analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Previous experience in analytics is strongly preferred.
Track record of good judgment around what to focus on and how to shape the deliverable.
Experience with SQL/Amplitude/Sigma for data analysis is a plus (and will be required to learn on the job).
Experience working with physical product logistics, e-commerce and/or subscription companies, ideally for a company with an international presence and in coordination with finance partners.
Experience designing and driving commerce business processes that integrate with platforms like Netsuite and Salesforce.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize requests from assertive cross-functional leaders and build consensus around a sequenced roadmap.
Strong written and oral communication skills to effectively communicate hypotheses, learnings, analysis, problems, and opportunities.

“Ready to lead the charge on AI startup creation across Canada? I’m looking for a Product Owner, Startups to join my team at Amii. In this role, you’ll lead a brilliant, high-performing team of startup enthusiasts, support an incredible network of AI founders from coast-to-coast-to-coast, and grow our thriving community of venture collaborators. If you’re passionate about scaling Canada’s AI ecosystem and empowering the next generation of deep tech founders, come make your mark with us”

One of Canada’s three main institutes for artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning, our world-renowned researchers drive fundamental and applied research at the University of Alberta (and other academic institutions), training some of the world’s top scientific talent. Our cross-functional teams work collaboratively with Alberta-based businesses and organizations to build AI capacity and…

sections.title: From the job description
paras: The Product Owner, Startups, leads a dynamic team that collaborates with aspiring entrepreneurs, researchers and innovative ventures to foster the creation and growth of AI-driven startups. This position owns Amii’s startup creation pipeline, including the Founders in Residence program, a critical component of the AI for All National Strategy, and bridges the gap between technical innovation and venture-backed success. It aligns with Amii’s mission of ‘AI for good and for all’ by serving as a trusted advisor to startup founders, technical leadership, academic researchers and ecosystem partners, ensuring technical founders have the resources, talent and guidance required to scale.

Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, the Product Owner, Startups drives the development and support of AI startups, architects and leads Amii’s startup creation pipeline, cultivates investor relationships, and fosters the growth of a multidisciplinary team. This position is pivotal in aligning the organization's resources and expertise with the needs and trends of the startup ecosystem, ensuring that both innovative solutions and strategic guidance meet the evolving demands of new AI ventures.
Leveraging cross-functional expertise, the Product Owner, Startups transfers knowledge to founders to strengthen internal capabilities and accelerate AI product roadmap.
The position focuses on achieving excellence in five main accountabilities:
bullets: Product Vision & Development: Identify, validate and develop all products and services with your cross-functional team members.

Startup Creation: Architect, launch, and lead Amii’s startup creation pipeline, including the Founders in Residence program and all associated builder-first programming. Translate academic research into venture-backed startups and support founders hands-on from idea generation to launch and scale.

Startup Ecosystem & Stakeholder Collaboration: Build team knowledge of the startup ecosystem, including venture and investment trends, and lead high-level relationships with peer National AI Institutes, investors and ecosystem partners to amplify national startup initiatives.
Client Success: Take a client-focused approach that emphasizes identifying and solving their business problems through a product lens.
People Leadership: Foster team development, while strategically managing structure, performance and standards, and direct how cross-functional resources support the startup portfolio.
Develops, owns and executes product strategy
Leads the product development and delivery process based on program participants’ needs and market challenges
Monitors, measures and provides updates to the executive team on product initiatives

bamboohr:armstrongfluidtechnology:1050.summary: Imagine working at the forefront of technology in mission-critical buildings/infrastructures industries, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence of nearly 100 years that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative technical and marketing minds, united by a shared mission to help our customers elevate building performance. Through smarter, more efficient solutions, we are helping to shape a more sustainable and carbon neutral world.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that improve energy efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and support the infrastructure our communities depend on every day. Every contribution helps lower global carbon footprints and brings us closer to a cleaner, more resilient future. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business, one that’s making our cities, and the world, more sustainable.

As a Regional Key Account Manager , you will be responsible for executing global account strategies within a designated geographic region by engaging with regional client teams, identifying regional opportunities and working closely with key internal stakeholders to drive strong sales performance and deep adoption of our technology within the account, through valuer articulation around energy efficiency, carbon abatement, and space optimization.
Own, Build, and Drive Key Regional Account Relationships
Collaborate and Develop Global Key Accounts with GKAM
bullets: Build and nurture trusted relationships with regional account decisionmakers including senior executives and operational leaders.
Develop a regional account map plan (“LAMP”: Large Account Management Plan) for each assigned account by identifying key local stakeholders across procurement, engineering, product, and operations.
Update and maintain a comprehensive repository of contacts, roles, and influence areas specific to the region.
Create account-specific action plans including the identification of local sales opportunities and areas for technology adoption.
Collaborate with the MPS (Modular Products and Solutions) offering team and other product Offering Managers to develop or adapt solutions for the unique needs of customers.
Build and nurture trusted relationships with regional decision-makers, including regional senior executives and operational leaders.

sections.title: From the job description
bullets: Connect with daily leads and guide them on how to buy cars from US auto auctions through our platform.
Handle the entire purchase cycle - from advising on the winning bid and guiding through payments, to final delivery at the buyer's destination.
Grow your assigned accounts and consistently meet monthly sales goals.

Native Georgian (spoken and written).
Russian and English B2 or higher (spoken and written).
1+ years in sales, preferably car sales, auto import/export, logistics or B2C/B2B phone sales.

bamboohr:flare:144.summary:
Flare is a breakout cybersecurity Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company with a mission to empower organizations to take control of their data and protect their customers, employees and brand by shedding light on external threats. We enable cybersecurity teams to proactively detect high-risk external exposure across the dark and clear web, before threat actors have a chance to leverage it. We unify the core functionalities of cyber threat intelligence and external attack surface management into a single, intuitive platform.

TL;DR: We are a bunch of nerds who help protect our clients’ data (and people in their network) by locating cyber risks.

sections.title: From the job description
bullets: Partner with the sales team to articulate the value of the Flare platform to prospective customers
Understand customer requirements, field technical questions, and demonstrate platform capabilities by finding a prospects exposures

Act as the analyst in the middle for enterprise customers and prospects, interpreting Flare findings in real time: leaked credentials, exposed infrastructure, threat actor mentions, and infostealer infections tied to their environment
Train sales team members on the technical aspects of Flare’s platform
Act as a technical consultant across Flare, supporting product, marketing, and other initiatives

bamboohr:prismstudio:44.summary:
About the Company
At AVANT Global Solutions, we build software that redefines how businesses operate. Our products automate key processes for our clients, many of them in manufacturing, bringing traceability, fewer human errors and greater efficiency. We are a fully remote, cross-disciplinary team that values ownership, clear communication and continuous learning.

About the Role
This is not a classic project management role. You will be the link between our factory clients, our leadership and our development team, and you will own the success of our ERP product with all three.

Our clients run real operations on our software. When something is urgent, unclear or going wrong, you’ll be the one who steps in, understands the problem, manages expectations and gets it resolved. You’ll turn what clients and leadership need into clear priorities the team can deliver, and you’ll make sure what…

sections.title: From the job description
paras: We work together as one team with one common goal. If you thrive where things move fast and people count on you, we’d love to hear from you.
bullets: Be the main point of contact for our ERP clients: run meetings, gather requirements, handle escalations and keep relationships strong under pressure.
Work with leadership on product priorities and roadmap, and report progress clearly and honestly.
Translate client and business needs into well-defined tasks and priorities for the development team.
Plan and track delivery, spot risks early, and adjust when priorities change.
Make decisions when information is incomplete, and explain the reasoning behind them.
Keep documentation, specs and client communication clear and up to date.
Do whatever it takes to move things forward, even when it’s outside the job description.
You have experience managing projects or products, ideally software, in a client-facing role.

bamboohr:virtuozzo:526.summary:
Virtuozzo develops infrastructure software for AI and the cloud. Our technology combines an optimised operating system with virtualisation, storage, orchestration, management, automation, and protection, helping service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and run efficient, scalable infrastructure.

We enable customers and partners to launch, operate, and grow cloud services on their own infrastructure and under their own brand. Our software delivers mainframe-like performance, reliability, and security while reducing infrastructure costs and operational complexity.

With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue contributing to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Virtuozzo builds infrastructure software for service providers, SaaS, and corporate partners: virtualisation, software-defined storage, and cloud services.

One of our largest partners embeds our product into its own branded cloud offering under an OEM agreement, and we are looking for a mid-to-senior-level professional to build and run a cross-functional team that delivers for this partner, working closely with our Product and TAM teams and release management.

You meet the Product, engineering, TAM, and release management teams and the partner’s main contacts. You go through product training and get hands-on with the platform, so you can follow technical discussions and know where to get data. You learn how the partner sells our product and which of its business goals depend on us.

With R&D leadership, you agree who is on the team, dedicated and shared, and how it plans and works with the rest of R&D. You take over the partner’s requests from the Product team and become the partner’s main contact on delivery.
bullets: Take in the partner’s business and technical requests. Find the business problem behind each one. The partner often brings a ready technical solution; with your engineering lead, decide whether to accept it as stated or go back to the problem.
Learn how the partner sells our product through MSPs and service providers and which requests matter for its sales and renewals. Use this to set priorities with the Product team.
With engineering and product teams, turn the requests into product requirements the team can estimate.
With the Product team, find where the partner’s requests overlap with our own roadmap so we build things once for everyone.
Build and run the requirements and change process with the partner: scope, freeze dates, change requests, impact assessment, and exceptions. Decide on late changes yourself, within that process.

Plan the work with the team and with release management, aligned with the partner’s own release schedule, get commitments, and deliver on them. When a date slips, tell the partner early and agree on a new plan.
Be the single point of contact for the partner on delivery: regular syncs, status, and escalations. Bring product management in when a product decision is needed, with the problem already clear.
Say “not in this release” to the partner when scope and dates are under pressure, defend the process and the team’s resources, and keep the relationship in good shape.

greenhouse:accenturefederalservices:4711.summary: A product-minded problem solver who connects mission needs, user value, stakeholder priorities, and technical delivery. You bring together product management, business analysis, and Agile delivery skills to help teams decide what to build, why it matters, and how to deliver the highest-value outcomes for federal clients. This capability posting is designed for candidates who may be building their product-management foundation or already be ready to independently own a product area, backlog, feature set, or stakeholder workstream. As your experience grows, you may define broader product vision and roadmaps, lead cross-team prioritization, mentor product practitioners, and influence portfolio-level product decisions.

sections.title: The work:
bullets: Discover and clarify mission, user, stakeholder, operational, and business needs through interviews, workshops, analysis, and collaboration.
Translate needs into product goals, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog items, and release priorities.
Support or lead backlog refinement, sprint/PI planning, product discovery, stakeholder alignment, demos, and decision-making activities.
Use product metrics, customer insights, delivery data, and prioritization frameworks to make tradeoff recommendations and communicate rationale.
Partner closely with Digital Experience Engineers, Business Application Engineers, Quality Engineers, platform teams, architects, design partners, and delivery leaders.
Help teams maintain alignment between product outcomes, technical feasibility, user value, quality, delivery constraints, and federal mission priorities.
Facilitate collaboration across business and technical stakeholders and communicate complex requirements, risks, and decisions in clear language.
Use AFS-approved AI-assisted tools and workflows to accelerate research synthesis, requirements analysis, backlog refinement, documentation, and product decision support while validating outputs.

sections.title: Here’s what you need:
bullets: Professional experience in product management, business analysis, requirements engineering, product ownership, Agile facilitation, or comparable client-facing delivery work, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience translating user, business, mission, or stakeholder needs into requirements, user stories, backlog items, acceptance criteria, or delivery priorities.
Experience collaborating with technical teams and communicating effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
Understanding of Agile/Scrum/SAFe delivery, backlog management, iterative development, and release planning.
For candidates with deeper experience, demonstrated ability to independently own product areas, lead discovery and prioritization, mentor others, and influence cross-team product decisions.

sections.title: Bonus points if you have:
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Miro, Lucidchart, Rally, or comparable product and delivery tools.
Experience with RICE, WSJF, OKRs, product analytics, customer research, service design, journey mapping, or process modeling.
Experience with federal consulting, government systems, regulated environments, or mission-oriented delivery.
Product Owner, Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile, business analysis, or product-management certification.
Experience working across product management, business analysis, and Agile facilitation responsibilities.
Ability to facilitate discussions, organize ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and take increasing ownership of product or stakeholder workstreams.

bullets: U.S. Citizenship required.
Ability to work with federal clients and comply with applicable AFS, client, security, and program requirements.
Ability to work in a hybrid, remote, or client-site environment as program needs require.

greenhouse:addepar1:8910404002.summary: Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

sections.title: The Role
paras: We are seeking an Early Career Product Manager to join the AI product management team. Our team owns some of Addepar's flagship AI products, including Addison, agentic workflows, and the Addepar MCP. Our mission is to accelerate front- and back-office work for the investment industry.

As an Early Career Product Manager, you'll get hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, working alongside senior PMs in a high growth, fast moving environment - leveraging the latest and greatest in conversational AI, agents, and emerging standards like MCP to build transformative new products that deliver value to clients. This role will require working closely with engineering, design, product, marketing, go-to-market to drive new AI products to success.

This is a fast-paced, cross-functional role for a hands-on operator who wants to get real AI products into clients' hands, making an impact at the intersection of AI, customer-centric product development, and financial technology.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Drive the end-to-end development of new AI features: help scope requirements, write specs, partner with engineering, design, and GTM to get them built and launched
Dig into how clients actually use our AI products today, surface what's working and what isn't, and turn those insights into clear, actionable product recommendations
Own well-defined pieces of the roadmap under the mentorship of senior PMs, with increasing autonomy
Get hands-on with the AI tools and techniques the team uses daily, including prompting, evaluating agent behavior, and understanding what makes an AI feature actually work in practice
Define product analytics focused on usage patterns, adoption, feature performance
Help the team stay organized and move fast: support operations, maintain product documentation, and triage incoming feedback and bugs
Work directly with cross-functional partners in engineering, design, marketing, and go-to-market to keep execution tight and stakeholders aligned

sections.title: Who You Are
paras: Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.
Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
bullets: 0–2 years of professional experience; strong internship, research, or project experience in a fast-paced, analytical environment is a plus
Genuinely excited about AI and how it's changing what products can do. You use AI tools yourself, you keep up with what's new, and you have opinions about where this is all headed
Sharp analytical instincts. You're comfortable breaking down ambiguous problems, working with data, and reasoning your way to a recommendation
A bias for ownership. You don't wait to be told exactly what to do — you ask good questions, make a plan, and move
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a technical idea clearly to both an engineer and a client
Comfortable communicating with senior stakeholders, whether that's a client or an executive
Low ego, high accountability. You're as comfortable digging into the details as you are stepping back to see the bigger picture
Drawn to fast-paced, high-growth environments where the problems are still being defined and the stakes are real

greenhouse:alarmcom:8842947002.summary: PointCentral is the leading smart property technology platform for residential rental communities — powering access, security, and automation across multifamily, single-family, build-to-rent, and short-term rental properties nationwide. We're a subsidiary of Alarm.com , which gives us the stability and infrastructure of a public company with the speed and ambition of a product-led startup.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Own partner-driven new-logo growth and all expansion within assigned partner-managed accounts, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, qualification, progression, and revenue outcomes.

Build and execute joint growth plans with Service Providers that activate more producing partners, identify portfolio expansion opportunities, and create a more diversified contribution model across the partner base.

Identify, recruit, onboard, and enable new Service Providers aligned to PointCentral's target markets, establishing clear success criteria to ensure newly added partners become active and productive contributors.

sections.title: Role Overview:
paras: We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Product Manager to own customer engagement outcomes from problem discovery through shipped impact.

This is not a traditional roadmap PM role, and it is not an implementation-only delivery role. You will sit at the intersection of customer, GTM, and engineering: understanding messy operational workflows, scoping the right MVP, translating customer needs into product requirements, and driving the engagement to measurable business value.

The core skill is turning ambiguity into shipped outcomes. You will work with customers who have complex workflows, fragmented data, security constraints, and high expectations. Your job is to create clarity, sequence the work, manage tradeoffs, and make sure what we build is useful for the customer and reusable for Bolo. For every customer engagement, especially pilots, the bar is not “did we deliver what we promised?” The bar is: did we create so much value that the customer does not want to live without Bolo when the pilot ends? This role is accountable for helping us reach that level of customer pull.

Partner with engineering to turn customer workflows and datasets into stable, extensible AI-powered solutions.
Manage tradeoffs across customer urgency, technical complexity, commercial value, and long-term product reuse.
Scope phased deployments that create value quickly without creating unsustainable custom work.
Lead customer rollout and adoption so shipped solutions become part of real workflows.

sections.title: What Success Looks Like:

You turn customer-specific learning into reusable product and delivery patterns.

greenhouse:cloverhealth:8345964.summary:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we deliver improved outcomes at lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the longitudinal patient record, one trusted view of the care each patient receives across every setting, from the primary care office to the specialist to a hospital stay. Every Counterpart product builds on this record.

Our clinical data comes from hundreds of sources, including health information exchanges, EHRs, labs, ADT feeds, pharmacy fills, prior authorizations, and claims from our health plan customers. Each one captures part of a patient's care. The longitudinal record connects them into one history of the patient's visits,…

sections.title: What you will own and improve
bullets: Product strategy. Set the vision and roadmap for the longitudinal record. Find the highest-value problems across the products and programs that depend on it, and make the trade-offs among completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and investment.

Data for every use case. The record serves providers at the point of care and the programs that depend on complete care history: quality measurement (HEDIS), risk adjustment and RADV audits, payment integrity, and revenue operations. Providers, quality analysts, and operational teams all work from the same care history.

How every source becomes part of the record. You own patient matching, deduplication, normalization, and clinical terminology mapping, which turn raw data from each source into a trusted part of the patient's record. Every new source runs through them, so improvements are built once and reused across products.

Adoption. A canonical field counts only when clinicians use it. You own the path from definition to adoption: requirements, a migration plan per use case, and retiring fragmented, duplicate versions of the same data.

sections.title: What success looks like
bullets: The record gets more complete, accurate, and timely, and you can show it with numbers.
Products and programs adopt the shared record and retire their own versions of it.
New customers and markets reach a usable patient record with less time and less one-off work.

You can show what those gains changed downstream: more complete evidence for quality and risk adjustment, earlier visibility into admissions and care transitions, and fewer inconsistencies across products.
You run a clear decision process with clinical and engineering partners, and definitions are documented, adopted, and applied consistently.

sections.title: About VulnCheck
paras: Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The Exploit Intelligence Company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers. VulnCheck's proprietary data is consumed directly by security teams and also licensed and integrated by other organizations — including enterprises, government agencies, and other cybersecurity vendors — into their own products and workflows.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The Product Marketing Lead will build and lead product marketing as a foundational function within VulnCheck's marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO. This is not a content role — it's a core product marketing function responsible for defining who we sell to, how we position and message our products, how we bring new products to market, and how our field and community understand and communicate our value. The ideal candidate is technically fluent in cybersecurity and comfortable operating at both the strategic level (ICP definition, positioning frameworks, GTM strategy) and the hands-on level (writing messaging, building enablement, running launches). This role is expected to bring on its first hire within 6–12 months as the function scales. This is a 100% remote role with preference for candidates located in the Boston, MA, Greater Austin, TX, or the Greater DMV region.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Product Launches & New Product Content: Lead GTM strategy and execution for new product and feature launches, partnering closely with Product to translate technical capabilities into market-ready narratives, launch plans, and supporting assets — including website copy, research reports, and sales collateral.

Field Enablement: Equip the sales team with the tools, training, battlecards, and content they need to sell effectively across all customer segments — including competitive positioning, objection handling, and use-case/vertical-specific selling assets.

Community & Industry Engagement: Partner with the community and customers to capture real-world proof points and success stories, and represent VulnCheck's product story at industry events, webinars, and analyst conversations, including flagship security conferences such as Black Hat and DEF CON.

Analyst Relations: Own the analyst relations program end-to-end — building and managing relationships with industry analysts, coordinating briefings and inquiries, and ensuring VulnCheck's positioning is reflected accurately in analyst coverage.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Run continuous competitive analysis and market research across our full competitive landscape to sharpen positioning and inform how we compete.

Team Building: Build the product marketing function from the ground up — establishing processes and priorities as an initial IC, then hiring and developing a team as scope grows (expected within 6–12 months).

sections.title: What You’ll Bring
bullets: 8+ years of product marketing experience in B2B cybersecurity technology, with meaningful experience in one or more of the following segments: threat intelligence, vulnerability management, attack surface management/CTEM, or EDR/XDR.
Prior people leadership or a clear track record of being ready to hire and manage within the first year, paired with comfort operating as a hands-on IC in the interim.

sections.title: Position Description:
paras: As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.

You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.

This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.

Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.

Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

smartrecruiters:experian:744000160746568.summary:
Experian Health provides industry-leading solutions for revenue cycle management, identity management, patient engagement and care management.

The Vice President of Product Management, Patient Financial Experience "PFE" owns a large portfolio of products in Experian Health. This portfolio includes patient scheduling, patient estimates, patient payments, financial clearance, statements, charity care support, collections optimization, and a few other related capabilities. This leader will set the multi-year strategy, investment thesis, and P&L accountability for a domain at the intersection of healthcare revenue cycle, consumer finance, and AI-driven automation. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will manage a team of product managers and serve as the internal and external face of the PFE product portfolio.

sections.title: Strategy & Investment Thesis
bullets: Define and own a differentiated multi-year product strategy that positions Experian Health as a category leader.
Translate market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and customer insight into a prioritized and focused investment roadmap and innovation pipeline.
Set the OKRs and roadmap for the portfolio, allocating investment across growth, optimization, and new opportunities.
Contribute to portfolio P&L performance - including revenue growth, margin, and retention - by partnering with Sales and Operations and supporting accountability for measurable outcomes.
Partner with Finance, Sales, and Client Success to define pricing and packaging, model commercial performance, size new opportunities, and build the business cases that drive investment decisions.

sections.title: Product Leadership
bullets: Set the standard for discovery rigor, launch excellence, and post-GA optimization across a mix of mature revenue cycle tools and emerging AI-powered capabilities.
Guide the portfolio through the full product lifecycle — from identifying high-impact bets to sunsetting products that no longer serve the market.

sections.title: People & Organization
bullets: Build, develop, and retain a high-performing PM organization that delivers on their OKRs and roadmaps.
Ensure team maintains accountability and can align the organization behind prioritized backlogs covering all development work
Ensure team can translate priorities into actionable work for the engineers and help coordinate dependencies and roadblocks.
Ensure team measures and communicates outcomes and are effectively reprioritizing and realigning teams to drive aligned OKRs.

sections.title: Market & Regulatory Fluency
bullets: Become the internal and external face of the PFE portfolio, able to represent Experian Health with our most strategic customers and present at industry conferences.
Maintain deep fluency in healthcare billing, consumer financial protection (CFPB, No Surprises Act, price transparency mandates), and charity care regulations.
Anticipate regulatory and competitive shifts and translate them into portfolio positioning and product requirements before they become reactive obligations.

smartrecruiters:mirantis:744000148987649.summary:
Mirantis is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager focused on k0rdent AI, our AI infrastructure platform. You will be responsible for how we bring k0rdent AI to market and how it is understood by the platform engineers and technical buyers who evaluate it.

You will turn the k0rdent AI story into the content that demand generation, sales, and the practitioner community rely on, translating product capabilities into technical blogs, solution briefs, tutorials, case studies, and enablement assets that resonate with a technical audience.

As part of the Product Marketing team, you will work hand in hand with engineering, product management, and solution architects to identify and promote the platform's value propositions and capabilities.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: The ideal candidate combines a technical background with strong editorial judgment and a track record of shipping on schedule. You will learn from real customer deployments, spot where the market misunderstands k0rdent AI, and use content performance data to refine what you publish and why.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Translate k0rdent AI capabilities into positioning and messaging for platform engineers and technical buyers, in partnership with product management and the broader Product Marketing team.
Author and publish technical blogs, solution briefs, tutorials, case studies, and launch kits, and maintain the editorial calendar that sequences them against campaign and launch timelines.

Partner with engineering, product management, and solution architects to develop content from PRDs, release notes, reference architectures, and field insight, and edit SME-authored drafts to a publishable standard.
Develop sales enablement assets, including pitch decks, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, and discovery aids, working directly with sales and pre-sales.
Produce hands-on content, including walkthroughs, how-to guides, and getting-started material based on live product workflows.
Support the customer proof program through reference interviews, quote and logo approvals, case studies, and testimonials.
Track content performance across traffic, engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and sales asset usage, and adjust the content mix accordingly.

sections.title: Required qualifications:
bullets: 6+ years in product marketing, technical content marketing, or developer marketing within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or enterprise software.
Demonstrated ability to convert a brief, a specification, or a subject-matter-expert conversation into a finished deliverable within a review cycle.
Strong copywriting and editing craft across long-form technical narrative and short-form copy, including the ability to bring SME-authored drafts to a publishable standard.
Working fluency in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and on-premises deployment patterns.
Baseline AI infrastructure literacy, including GPU cluster fundamentals, training versus inference workloads, and scheduling and multi-tenancy concepts.
Experience building sales enablement material and working directly with sales and pre-sales teams.
Working knowledge of AEO/SEO fundamentals and experience collaborating with demand generation and marketing operations.
Portfolio of published technical writing, including blogs, tutorials, solution briefs, or case studies.

sections.title: Soft Skills and team fit:
bullets: Curious about how AI infrastructure works.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable with engineers, product managers, and executives.
Manages multiple projects and deadlines.
Passion for developer communities and the cloud-native ecosystem.
Bias toward shipping content and iterating quickly.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001568565.summary:
ServiceNow is seeking a customer obsessed Senior Staff Outbound Product Manager to join the Data & Analytics product team responsible for Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB. This is an externally focused role for a product leader who can bring complex enterprise data capabilities to market through clear positioning, product launches, sales enablement, and direct customer engagement.

This role sits at the intersection of data architecture, platform performance, analytics, AI readiness, and customer value. You will help shape how ServiceNow customers understand, adopt, and unlock value from advanced data capabilities, translating deep technical concepts into compelling product narratives, go-to-market strategies, customer-facing content, and field enablement.

sections.title: Business Context
paras: Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB Professional are strategically important growth areas within ServiceNow’s Data & Analytics portfolio. The business is already significant, with approximately $600M in revenue and a goal to grow to $1.5B by 2029. The opportunity is not simply to sell data as a standalone product, but to build a clear wraparound strategy for how data enhances ServiceNow’s value proposition across workflows, customer outcomes, enterprise AI readiness, and strategic deal pursuits.

The right leader will identify the customer problem, craft the market narrative, and help scale field enablement and growth strategies through one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many motions. This person will partner closely with product, engineering, sales, solution consulting, product marketing, and customer-facing teams to ensure the market understands the value of ServiceNow’s next-generation data platform.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the outbound product strategy for Workflow Data Fabric and RaptorDB Professional, translating complex data platform capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, and compelling market narratives.
Define and refine the core messaging, use cases, personas, competitive differentiation, and customer proof points that help technical and executive audiences understand why these products matter.

Partner closely with inbound product managers, engineering, product marketing, sales, solution consulting, and customer-facing teams to shape launch strategy, field readiness, growth motions, and adoption plans.

Serve as a product evangelist in customer briefings, executive conversations, analyst sessions, webinars, conferences, and strategic deal support, adapting the message for both technical practitioners and business decision-makers.

Translate concepts across enterprise data, analytics, integration, platform performance, and AI readiness into clear business outcomes, customer use cases, and seller-ready messaging without requiring audiences to navigate unnecessary technical depth.
Turn field feedback, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and adoption signals into actionable recommendations that influence roadmap priorities, GTM execution, and outbound investments.

Own high-impact outbound deliverables, including sales playbooks, product launch campaigns, demos, solution briefs, competitive guides, field training, executive presentations, and customer-facing product storytelling.
Help establish and track success metrics for outbound initiatives, including launch readiness, seller adoption, customer engagement, pipeline influence, product adoption, and market feedback.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 10+ years of enterprise software product management, outbound product management, technical product marketing, or go-to-market experience, including ownership of customer-facing launches, positioning, field enablement, and sales plays.
Enterprise software experience is required, with a strong preference for candidates who have built, positioned, sold, or taken software products to market for external enterprise customers.
Product management or outbound product experience as a builder or seller of software, not solely as an internal IT practitioner, implementation owner, or user of similar technologies.

Strong working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics—including data platforms, databases, integrations, cloud infrastructure, analytics, or AI/ML data layers—with the ability to translate these capabilities into differentiated positioning and customer value. Deep engineering or architecture ownership is not required.
Strong understanding of how data strategy, integration, data management, databases, and platform capabilities support enterprise AI and workflow transformation.

Demonstrated experience engaging external enterprise customers, sellers, and executives through briefings, discovery conversations, launches, field events, or strategic deal support—and using those interactions to sharpen messaging and go-to-market execution.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity for technical practitioners, business decision-makers, sellers, executives, and customer stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross-functionally across product, engineering, marketing, sales, solution consulting, customer success, and field teams.

Experience developing field enablement, launch narratives, competitive positioning, customer proof points, executive messaging, and adoption programs.
